description: Run a reel live and read its transcript: each step's tool, arguments, status, time and answer, the outcome in one line, and an Ed25519 signature over the transcript checkable at /.well-known/quote-keys.json when signing is configured. Every read is a fresh run on the keyless demo, so it shows what the API answers now, not a recording. It spends your own demo allowance. Public: needs no credential. Until it is switched on it answers not released.

reel_id.description: Which reel to run; list_reels lists them.

name: get_reel
